extraction.Name: Kate Miller (Duran)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 23, 1918, Rosebud, S. Dak., but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Anthony N. Glasser for a consideration of $10,000, subject to mortgage of $6,000 assumed by Glasser
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612804 issued; Northwest quarter of section 29, township 96, range 70; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 1, 1918; land mortgaged first time on February 18, 1918 for $4,000; mortgaged second time August 8, 1918 for $2,000; by deed dated November 11, 1918 signed by Kate and Charles Duran, land conveyed to Anthony N. Glasser for $10,000 subject to mortgage of $6,000 assumed by Glasser
